category_title: Disengaged ninth grader struggling with decoding and social anxiety
minimal_context: Harry and the tutor are working on an English 9E homework assignment that requires reading a story with detailed rising and falling action.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start on your English 9E homework. We need to read this story and look at the rising and falling action.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I try to try, but again, like, the homework is just overwhelming. I really dislike reading.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to read the first few paragraphs for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is boring. I don't want to read all these details.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep going, let's see what happens next in the text.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm getting impatient with this detailed storyline. I just want the story to quickly get to the good part. If it's not creepy or kind of weird, I don't want to read it.
